name: Kind of Blue
description: Miles Davis's landmark 1959 modal jazz album, featuring John Coltrane and Bill Evans. One of the best-selling jazz records of all time.

name: Rumours
description: Fleetwood Mac's 1977 soft rock masterpiece recorded amid the band's personal turmoil. Contains classics like 'Go Your Own Way' and 'Dreams'.

name: Purple Rain
description: Prince and The Revolution's 1984 soundtrack album blending funk, rock and pop. The title track remains one of the greatest guitar ballads ever recorded.

name: Nevermind
description: Nirvana's 1991 breakthrough record that propelled grunge into the mainstream. 'Smells Like Teen Spirit' became the anthem of a generation.

name: Blue
description: Joni Mitchell's deeply personal 1971 singer-songwriter album. Widely regarded as one of the greatest albums ever made for its raw emotional honesty.

name: Innervisions
description: Stevie Wonder's 1973 soul and funk odyssey exploring social and political themes. Features the hit 'Higher Ground' and 'Living for the City'.

name: The Dark Side of the Moon
description: Pink Floyd's 1973 progressive rock concept album examining the human condition. Spent a record-breaking 937 weeks on the Billboard 200.

name: What's Going On
description: Marvin Gaye's 1971 concept album addressing war, poverty and environmental destruction. A cornerstone of soul music and social commentary.

name: Tapestry
description: Carole King's 1971 singer-songwriter classic featuring 'I Feel the Earth Move' and 'You've Got a Friend'. Won four Grammy Awards including Album of the Year.

name: Ready to Die
description: The Notorious B.I.G.'s 1994 debut that defined East Coast hip-hop. A cinematic portrait of street life in Brooklyn with unforgettable lyricism.

name: Horses
description: Patti Smith's 1975 debut album blending punk rock with beat poetry. Produced by John Cale, it opened with a reimagining of Van Morrison's 'Gloria'.

name: Graceland
description: Paul Simon's 1986 world music fusion album recorded in South Africa with local musicians. Won the Grammy for Album of the Year and introduced mbaqanga to global audiences.
